agents.register-cost.definition: SOL cost (rent plus fees) to register an agent in the Solana Agent Registry.
agents.register-cost.note: Public figures conflict: 8004-solana SDK docs about 0.00319 SOL (PDA rent), 8004-MCP docs about 0.01 SOL including the ATOM stats account; confirm against the program.

agents.feedback-cost.definition: SOL cost to leave feedback in the Solana Agent Registry.
agents.feedback-cost.note: No primary source; 8004-MCP docs list about 0.0005 SOL. Confirm with the program owners.

agents.set-wallet-cost.definition: SOL cost to set an agent wallet in the Solana Agent Registry.
agents.set-wallet-cost.note: No primary source; SDK docs list updates at about 0.000005 SOL (transaction fee only).
